proposals.defect: Permanent (non-retryable) provider failures trigger an extra 'last chance' adapter.execute call after the retry loop, causing a second provider interaction.
The whole retrying loop is re-run with a fresh retry controller when the error is not classified retryable, so permanent failures are re-sent to the provider and retried as if transient.
